defaults.motion_elements: the wreaths, the lights and the falling snow
defaults.ambient: Snow falls gently over the fields.

shots.subject: A red barn with a big pine wreath on its hayloft door standing in a white snowy field, warm string lights along its roofline and a wooden fence curving across the field in front
A wooden covered bridge over a half-frozen stream in a snowy valley, pine garlands and warm lights around its entrance, dark water flowing beneath
shots.motion_elements: the garland lights, the flowing stream and the falling snow
shots.ambient: Snow falls gently over the fields. The stream flows slowly under the bridge.

shots.subject: A snowy country lane with a plain wooden mailbox on a post wrapped in pine garland and warm fairy lights, a split-rail fence running along the lane toward a distant farmhouse
A white farmhouse with a wraparound porch and a big decorated fir glowing in the snowy front yard, smoke from the chimney, open fields behind
shots.motion_elements: the tree lights, the chimney smoke and the falling snow
shots.ambient: Snow falls gently over the fields. Chimney smoke drifts slowly.

shots.subject: A dry-stone wall with an old wooden gate hung with a pine wreath and warm lights, a snowy pasture and a line of bare trees beyond
A small white village church with a slender steeple in a wide snowy valley, a lit tree by its door and a few farmhouses scattered along the valley floor
A farmyard with an old wooden hay wagon piled with snow and draped with garland and warm lights, a stone farmhouse and a red barn behind
Close view of a pine wreath with a red velvet bow and pine cones on a weathered barn door, tiny warm fairy lights glowing in it, snowflakes settling on the needles
shots.focus: the wreath on the barn door

shots.subject: A winding snowy country road between rolling white hills lined with tall bare trees, a farmhouse at the bend with warm lights and a wreath on every window
An old wooden water mill beside a flowing stream, icicles hanging from its still wheel, garland and warm lights along its porch, snowy banks around
shots.motion_elements: the porch lights, the flowing stream and the falling snow
shots.ambient: Snow falls gently. The stream flows past the mill.

shots.subject: A hilltop orchard of bare apple trees in snow, one old tree wrapped in warm lights, a farmhouse in the valley below
A small roadside farm stand shed with a wreath on its front, stacks of firewood and baskets of pine cones, warm string lights along its eaves and a snowy field behind
Close view of a snowy wooden fence post topped with a small glowing lantern, pine garland and a red ribbon wrapped around the rails, the white fields blurred behind
shots.motion_elements: the lantern flame, the fairy lights and the falling snow
shots.ambient: The lantern flame flickers softly. Snow falls gently.

shots.subject: Snowy rolling farmland seen from above, white fields divided by dark hedgerows and stone walls, a farmhouse with lit windows and a big lit tree at the centre
shots.focus: the farmhouse and its lit tree

shots.subject: A snowy farmhouse front porch with two wooden rocking chairs under plaid blankets, pine garland with warm lights along the railing, a wreath on the door and lanterns on the steps
A red barn and a tall silo at golden hour, the low sun warming the snow, long fence shadows and warm lights glowing along the barn roof
shots.motion_elements: the barn lights and the drifting clouds
shots.ambient: The barn lights twinkle softly. Clouds drift slowly across the sky.

shots.subject: An old stone bridge over a flowing brook in the countryside, a lamp post wrapped in garland and warm lights at one end, snowy willows along the banks
shots.motion_elements: the lamp post lights, the flowing brook and the falling snow
shots.ambient: Snow falls gently. The brook flows under the bridge.

shots.subject: Close view of a vintage metal milk churn beside a barn door with a small pine wreath hung on it, warm fairy lights and snowflakes settling on its lid
A long line of snow-covered round hay bales across a white field, a red barn behind them with warm lights strung along its fence
shots.focus: the hay bales and the red barn

shots.subject: Close view of a snowy winterberry bush with bright red berries beside a country fence, warm fairy lights woven through its branches
